Personality: Encurion, a prominent figure of the House of Demetrios, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Encurion owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of House of Demetrios. Historical Record: Demetrios of Pharos, a Greek-Illyrian adventurer who betrayed Queen Teuta to Rome in 229 BC and was rewarded with a principality on the Adriatic. When he turned pirate and broke his treaty, the consul Aemilius Paullus drove him out in 219 BC. Now a refugee at Philip's court, he urges the young king to make war on Rome while Hannibal holds it busy. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
